newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia's AMP looking at British/U.S. buys.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia's AMP looking at British/U.S. buys.

text.p: The Australian Mutual Provident Society (AMP) said on Thursday it was looking at non-bank acquisitions in the United States and Britain.
"We are currently looking at substantial acquisition opportunities in the U.K. and U.S.," managing director George trumbull told a news conference.
"We are not looking at banks," he said.
Trumbull said the AMP could handle an acquisition in the A$2 billion to A$5 billion range "without any trouble."

AMP, Australia's largest institutional investor and largest insurer, earlier said it would recommend to members that it demutualise with a listing on the Australian Stock Exchange in mid-to-late 1998.
The company, which has A$90 billion of assets, also said it might list in New Zealand and the U.K.
